content:
claire_peopleops: quick follow-up from today's all-hands Q&A. collecting short answers managers can copy into 1:1s and promo packets.
ryan_total_rewards: TL;DR: retro is to the effective date; payroll cutoff determines when it shows up. bonuses use the band that applies on payout calc date; proration by days in band.
sophie_ceo: can we have a one-line script and a tiny checklist managers can paste?
nate_engineering_mgr: and please confirm who signs if the manager leaves mid-process. we had that happen last month.
claire_peopleops: yes. answers below. keep these verbatim for managers.

claire_peopleops: Retro pay / payroll timing
- retro pays back to the effective date, not the approval date.
- payroll cutoff: if approvals clear before cutoff for next pay run, retro appears in that run; if not, it posts in the following run (typical 1-pay-period lag).

ryan_total_rewards: Bonus eligibility & proration
- payout uses the role/band as of the payout calculation date; if promo effective date is before that date, the new band applies.
- bonuses prorated by days in band during the performance window. contact total-rewards for edge cases.

claire_peopleops: Who signs if manager leaves mid-process
- primary: skip-level manager signs.
- fallback: director or People Ops signs to avoid blocking payroll. record signer and rationale in the packet.

claire_peopleops: Promotions while on leave
- allowed if manager recommends and there is sufficient evidence. time on leave does not automatically pause promos; calibration may request extra context.

ryan_total_rewards: Equity note
- existing RSU vest schedules do not change automatically on promotion. any new grants tied to the promo will be separate and communicated in their own memo.

claire_peopleops: Compact manager checklist (paste into packet):
- Employee name, proposed title/band
- Effective date (YYYY-MM-DD) + "RETRO? yes/no"
- 2 concrete impact bullets + 1 supporting link
- Proposed comp (base + bonus target) and currency if applicable
- Signer (skip-level/director) & contact email

claire_peopleops: One-line manager script (copy):
"Congrats <name>  we're promoting you to <new title> effective <date>. This reflects your impact on <project/metric>. Payroll and People Ops will follow up with timing and paperwork. Reach out with Qs."

amir_engineer: can we get a shorter script for folks on leave?
claire_peopleops: sure: "Congrats <name>. We're promoting you to <new title> effective <date>. We'll complete paperwork while you're on leave and confirm comp timing; we can discuss details when you're back if you prefer."

people-ops-bot: Promo packet template link uploaded: https://drive.google.com/example-promo-quick (auto-note)

claire_peopleops: next steps: i'll post a 1-pager in #managers with these bullets and the template link by EOD and schedule two 20-min office hours for packet walkthroughs. drop edge cases here and we'll triage.
sophie_ceo: perfect, thanks team :tada:
